text:
Type: tall bamboo shelving tower
Use: storing towels, toiletries, plants and books in a narrow space; bathroom, living room, bedroom
Style: Japandi, coastal, bohemian
Materials: lacquered bamboo frame and shelves
Colors: warm golden bamboo, light honey
Shape: very tall narrow open tower in two stacked sections, slim square posts, small shelves on several levels, open on all sides, slender and airy, low visual weight
Feel: natural, light, calm, fresh
Goes with: white walls, green plants, linen, woven baskets, light stone; Japandi, spa-like or coastal rooms
